dormant.scene: Tall old Library lower Observatory, dull brass orrery with eight concentric orbital rings, ten dark planet spheres under dust and three further small dark outer-edge spheres; doorway back, lectern and restrained star charts; cool blue-charcoal moonlight, quiet and abandoned; big simple shapes readable at360x800. No characters, UI, text or particles. Owner concept approval only, not final game art.
dormant.style: Western hand-drawn feature (Prince of Egypt, Iron Giant, Atlantis, Treasure Planet, Sinbad); clean dark-brown outlines, flat fills, one hard-edged shadow and rim light; deep shadow masses, one motivated key light; collected, not cluttered. Charcoal #1C1A1F, line #2B1C16, amber #E3A34A, crimson #7C2A32, bone #EADCC3, cool blue #3A5578. No photorealism, 3D gloss, soft airbrush, reflective floors, anime, clutter or ornate filigree.
